chapter.verse: Nipi ni khatvei Zeisu in Farisaite upa khat’ inn sungah an ne dinga a lut ciangin, amaute in amah a en uh hi.
Tuipuak natna vei khat in ama mai-ah a om hi.
Zeisu in, “Nipi ni-in cinatna damsak tuak ahi hiam, damsak tuak lo ahi hiam?” ci-in thukham siate leh Farisaite kiangah a dot ciangin pau loin a om uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Zeisu in tua pa a damsak khit ciangin a paikhiasak hi.
Zeisu in, “Mi khat in la ahi zongin, bawng ahi zongin nei a, Nipi ni-in leihawm sungah kia leh, thakhatin a lakhia lo ding note lakah kua ahi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin,
amau in a dawng kik thei kei uh hi.
A kisamte in tokhom sangbel a teel uh Zeisu in a muh ciangin, amaute kiangah thugentehna a hilh-inah,
“Mi khatpeuh in mo la lawmvakna-ah note hong sap ciangin, tokhom a sang belna-ah na tu kei un. Tua bangin na tut leh, nangmah sangin a lianzaw khat kisam kha a;
hong sampa leh amah hong pai-in, ‘Hih pa ading omna na awn in,’ hong ci ding hi. Tua ciangin zumna tawh a niampen munah na tu ding hi.

Mi khatpeuh in hong sap ciangin pai in la, omna niam ah na tu in. Nang hong sampa hong pai ciangin, ‘Lawm aw, a sangah na tuto in,’ hong ci ding hi. Tua lai takin, nang tawh an a ne khawm mi khempeuhte mai-ah minthan’na na ngah ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama pumpi a phat mi khempeuh in niamkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi. A kiniamkhiat mi in minphatna a ngah ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

A sampa kiangah Zeisu in, “Sun an ahi zongin, nitak an ahi zongin na vaak ciangin, na lawmte ahi zongin, na u na nau ahi zongin, na beh na phung ahi zongin, sumhau na inn veengte ahi zongin na sam kei in. Tua bangin na sap leh, amaute in nang hong sam kikin, nang hong thuk ding uh hi.
Pawi na kham ciangin mizawngte, mipoite, khebaite leh mittawte na sam in.
Amaute in nang hong thukkik nading bangmah nei lo uh ahih ciangin, thupha na ngah ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midikte’ thawhkik ni ciangin nang hong kithukkik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu tawh an a nekhawm mi khat in tua thu a zak ciangin, “Pasian’ Gam sungah an a nei dingte in thupha ngah ding hi,” a cih leh,
Zeisu in, “Mi khat in pawipi kham a, mi tampi a sam hi.
An nek a hun ciangin, ‘Hong pai un. Tu-in na khempeuh a baihsa-in om hi,’ ci-in a khohsate kiangah gen dingin a nasempa a sawl hi.
Amaute khempeuh in kithutuakin kam a zong uh hi. A masa pen in, ‘Lo ciing khat ka lei a, pai-in ka va en ding hi. Kei hong maisak in,’ ci-in a ngen hi.
Khat in, ‘Ke’n bawng kap nga ka nei zo hi. Tel-et dingin ka va pai ding hi. Kei hong maisak in,’ ci-in thu a ngen hi.
Khat leuleu in, ‘Ke’n zi ka pi zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin kong hawh man kei ding hi,’ a ci hi.

Nasempa ciah a, tua thu khempeuh a topa a zasak hi. Tua lai takin inn teekpa heh a, “Khua sung lamlian ah ahi zongin, lamneu ah ahi zongin pai in la, mizawngte, mipoite, mittawte, khebaite hong tumpih in,’ ci-in a nasempa sawl hi.
A nasempa in, ‘Topa aw, na cih mah bangin ka sap hangin omna a awng lai hi,’ a ci hi.
A topa in, ‘Ka inn a dim nadingin lampi leh lo lamah pai in la, amaute zawhthawhna tawh hong tumsak in.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, a kikhosate ahih uh leh, khat beek in ka an a ciam kei ding hi,’ ci-in a nasempa thu a pia hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin mihonpite in Zeisu tawh a paikhawm uh hi.

Amah kihei a, “Kei kiangah hong pai nuamte in a nute, a pate, a zite, a tate, a sanggampate, a sanggamnute ahi zongin, tua tham loin ama nuntakna nangawn a muhdah kei leh, keima nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi.
A singlamteh pua a, ka nung hong zui lote in keima nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khat in inn sangpi a lam nop leh, a zawhzawh nading dangka a nei hiam ci-in a masa-in tu-in, a sim phot lo note lakah kua om ahi hiam?
Ahih kei leh, a khuam a phuh khit ciangin, inn a zop zawh kei leh, a mu mi khempeuh in
“Hih pa in inn lam ding a kipat khit ciangin a zom zo kei hi,’ ci-in amah a ko ding uh hi.
Ahih kei leh, kumpi khat in adang kumpipa tawh kido dingin a paikhiat ciangin, then nih tawh hong kuante then khat tawh nang zo ding hiam ci-in a masa-in tu-a lungngai lo kumpi om ding hiam?
A zawh kei ding leh, adang kumpipa gamla-ah a om lai takin upa sawl a, gal kilem nading thu a ngen ding hi.
Tua mah bangin note lakah mi khatpeuh in a neihsa khempeuh a nusiat kei leh, ka nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi.”
“Tua ahih ciangin ci apha hi. Ahih hangin a alna a man’ leh, bangci a al kik ding hiam?
Lei ading ahi zongin, eekkholna ading ahi zongin apha kei hi. Mite in pua lamah a paikhia uh hi. Zak nading bil a nei teng in na za ta un!” a ci hi.
